scope: Addressed remaining20 bone recovery methods; no production edits, no old heavy tests repeated
methodStatusNote: Assessment is not execution; not_attempted/conditional/image-route means future work remains. No blanket claim that all methods are exhausted.

newSources.institution: Department of Biomechanical Engineering, University of Twente
newSources.commercialUse: permitted subject to attribution/license link/change indication; not anatomical admission
newSources.provenance: New independent CT segmentation of NLM Visible Human, aligned CT redistributed by University of Denver; male subject 39 years, 1.80 m
limitations: Different donor/pose from BP3D. No bone replacement/admission.
STL headers explicitly SPACE=LPS; source units need independent spacing validation before integration.
Sesamoids absent explicitly; phalanges grouped by digit.
Toe I/V and hand I/III grouped meshes are each one connected component, so connected-component splitting does not yield individual bones.
Talus and MT V not watertight on analysis import; tiny disconnected islands must not be removed without source review.

newSources.reason: Current node_license remains null; description is imaging data for Anatomical Record review. Article/pubic download does not establish distribution rights for the specific models. No large geometry download repeated.

newSources.scientificLocator: Fig. 1 caption, p.160: right human hand from CT, radial/ulnar pollical sesamoids; supplementary item 1 STL. Study main sample is great apes, do not substitute their supplementary item 2 for the human model.
newSources.reason: Article metadata copyright2019 Anthropological Society of Nippon; free access is not a commercial derivative license. Supplement API attempt redirected to generic homepage; no mesh downloaded or treated as absent. Need actual human supplement plus explicit commercial derivative rights and specimen/axes/scale.

newSources.author: Brian H
newSources.reason: Public file page accessible; download link not retrieved. Side, voxel spacing, patient provenance, resolution and presence of two sesamoids unverified; sesamoid keyword alone is not proof. No images downloaded.
Data availability says not publicly available; anonymized version may be shared on request. Article license does not automatically license scans. No contact sent.

methods.summary: Original left BP3D source exists; prior quality/overlap diagnostics reused unchanged.
New BoneHub male STL retrieved at pinned commit with CC BY4.0. Technical inventory done; anatomical registration to BP3D remains unverified.
Original versus mirrored BP3D was already compared; new permission does not remove recorded joint conflicts.
Each bone already has an individual mesh. Surface repair/segmentation requires independent articular boundaries; removing intersection triangles alone is not anatomical correction.
Closed candidate shape already exists. No validated shape/pose constraints identify which intersecting surface is wrong; arbitrary shift/scale/deformation is not justified.

BoneHub exposes aligned CT and region seg.nrrd of one donor under source license. Not downloaded or segmented in this bounded pass. Same-source images could resolve fused phalanges/islands; cannot be assumed already validated or compatible with BP3D.
methods.nextStep: Inspect spacing/directions and relevant CT slices of one licensed donor, independently label joint boundaries; then evaluate a coherent regional replacement or separate educational specimen, preserving working BP3D models until justified.
